summary: Tested 6 features. Backend: ashore_since set on a land ping, kept on later land pings, cleared on water, new on the next land ping; my-phone; shore/track skipper + skipper_phone; arrived 404 guard. 6/6 pytest pass. UI: Phone From Profile fill PASS. Ashore 'Arrived?' prompt PASS (Not yet snoozes and holds over a reload; after clearing the snooze, Arrived ends tracking, toast 'Trip finished. Told 2 shore contacts...'). Ship's Log line on archive PASS, and Undo removes it again. Shore call button PASS (tel:+64215551234, text has the skipper name; the no-phone text shows when blank). Sign-out reminder: the dialog shows when the phone is blank, and no dialog shows when it's filled. 'Sign out anyway' PASS. 'Save and sign out' FAILS: it signs out, but the phone is never saved (reproduced 2x, no PUT /api/me/boat is sent).

minor.issue: Looks up crew_register across ALL owners by email_key, so a phone another skipper typed for this email can fill this user's Skipper's Phone. This matches the spec ('latest crew registration with the skipper's email'), but the phone is unverified.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Save and sign out' signs out without saving the phone. save(phone) calls mutate(), which only queues setPending. mbp_outbox_v3 is written in a useEffect after the re-render, and the PUT is debounced 700 ms. The loop `for (i<30 && unsynced()>0)` checks unsynced() synchronously before any await, reads 0, exits at once, and calls onLeave -> logout(). POST /auth/logout ends the session, so the PUT never happens. Verified: the only request after the click was POST /auth/logout 200, and Mongo user_boats.boat.skipper_phone stayed ''.

issues: The header says 'Skipper: Pro Tester' (account name), but the call button says 'Call the skipper (TEST_Skipper)' (Boat Details skipper). The two names don't match.

action_items: Fix PhoneReminderDialog Save and sign out. Either await the cloud save directly (e.g. api.put('/me/boat') with the updated state, or a save fn from useBoatStore that returns a promise), or wait for pending>0 then pending==0 (e.g. await wait(800) before polling, or poll until the outbox goes up and then back to 0). Retest: GET /api/me/boat shows boat.skipper_phone after sign-out.
Optional: use the same skipper name on the /shore header and the call button.
critical_code_review_comments: PhoneReminderDialog: the outbox-polling race described above.
AshorePrompt: snooze() overwrites the whole mbp_ashore_snooze object with a single trip key. Fine for one boat, but snoozing boat B un-snoozes boat A for a skipper with several boats.

AshorePrompt: depends on shoreTrack.tracking refreshing. ashore_since only reaches the client via the track/points response and /boats/{id}/shore, so a skipper whose phone stops pinging ashore may not see the prompt until the next fetch.
Arrived keeps ashore_since in the stored tracking doc (tracking_brief hides it when off). PUT tracking on starts a fresh dict, so there's no stale carry-over. OK.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (11/12 checks; Save and sign out fails)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ password accounts (test_ui156_*), plus one crew_register entry for account A; all deleted afterwards. On test-user-pro/main: set tracking.ashore_since in Mongo, tapped Arrived, then restarted tracking (new trip_id 4318697e...). Archived Route Planning and undid it (archives list empty; routeHazards, weather and shipsLog match the earlier copy except the item ts). Set skipper_phone temporarily and restored it to ''. Raised panPan alert 14d6f860... and stood it down. Final state: tracking on, distress cleared, skipper_phone blank.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use fresh /api/auth/register accounts for sign-out tests: logout ends the session. For the pro boat, tracking state comes from GET /api/boats/main/shore (not /me/boat). Land coord -39.60,175.60 counts as land; -36.60,175.00 counts as water. The trip-finish-mail-* controls are checkboxes, default ticked; clicking unticks them. The Undo button is in [data-sonner-toast]. To check the phone saved after Save and sign out, query Mongo user_boats directly (the session is gone).
